metadata.coordinate_processing: New roads: HK1980 geographic to WGS84 (EPSG:4611 to EPSG:4326). Existing roads pinned by stable ROUTE_ID to the retained source snapshot; over 400 shared sections validate the datum within 2.5 cm. Connected endpoints checked after conversion.
metadata.note: Original XY preserved. ELEVATION is a relative road level, not metres. Depth 32 m, widths, 5.6 m interior height, land aprons and scenery are authored. Selected approach levels are simplified; turn restrictions are not inferred.
